title: Tests fail because of shared state (parseDuration cache + mutating addDuration)
plan_task: T5 - investigate a test that fails for a non-obvious reason
notes: Planted cause: a cache in parseDuration (src/locales/en/constants.ts) returns the same object, and addDuration (src/calculation/duration.ts) mutates the object it receives for fractional values. Making addDuration immutable is NOT a valid fix (it breaks 'Test - The normal within expression'). The root cause in the report is checked by a person (rubric.md): the status stays pending_grading until eval/grade.py --score 2.
